question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

My brother has ______ missing.
solution:
The correct answer is '**gone**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb '**gone**' is used to indicate that someone is not present.
 
• In this context, 'gone missing' means that the brother is lost or unaccounted for.
 
• The other options do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *My brother has gone__ missing.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Set (स्थापित)**: to put something in a particular place or position.
 
• **Done (किया हुआ)**: to have carried out or completed an action.
 
• **Moved (हिलाना)**: to change position or place.
